evals.prompt: I want to build a new AVA for our telecom company. It should handle account balance inquiries and payment processing.
evals.expected_output: The skill calls list_resources(resource_type="ava"), finds no existing AVAs (or presents results), and offers to start the new AVA creation flow by routing to the design skill with mode=new.
assertions: list_resources MCP tool is called with resource_type="ava" to establish org context
User is offered the option to create a new AVA
Handoff to design skill is mentioned with mode=new

evals.prompt: I need to update my existing Order Status AVA. The instructions are too verbose and I want to tighten them up.
evals.expected_output: The skill calls list_resources(resource_type="ava"), presents the existing AVAs, asks the author to select the target AVA, classifies the change as a targeted edit, and routes to the design skill in update mode.
assertions: list_resources MCP tool is called with resource_type="ava"
User is prompted to select which AVA to update
Change is classified as targeted edit (instructions update)
Routed to design skill in update mode
Handoff includes mode=update and the selected agent_id

evals.prompt: I want to add a new tool to my existing Billing AVA — it needs to be able to process refunds through a new DataAction we just set up.
evals.expected_output: The skill calls list_resources(resource_type="ava"), identifies the Billing AVA, classifies the change as a new capability addition, and routes to the design skill in update mode — design handles tool discovery internally.
assertions: list_resources MCP tool is called with resource_type="ava"
Change involving new tool is identified
Routed to design skill in update mode
Handoff includes the selected agent_id and change description
